September 18 – November 20, 2025 Thursdays | 11:30 – 1:30 pm | Age 55+ Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio 50 Victoria Street, Aurora This course is for participants (ages 55+), who want to expand and experiment with additional techniques. Learn about choosing paints, painting surfaces and how to make the most of your tools. Colour theory and mixing will be explored as well as composition and mixed media. Courses tailored for adults 55+ encourage discovery, creativity and social connection in an environment that supports effective learning strategies for mature learners.
